description: Deterministic vulnerable/hardened form-login web app with a login -> view item -> transfer workflow. vuln=127.0.0.1:8831, hardened=127.0.0.1:8832. All credentials and data are lab-only fakes.

seeded_findings.title: BOLA: alice's session renders bob's item page
seeded_findings.proof: alice logs in, navigates to /items/2 (owner_id 2 = bob) and the page renders Bob's notebook

seeded_findings.title: BFLA: non-admin session reaches the admin panel
seeded_findings.proof: alice's session GETs /admin and gets 200 with the admin statistics page

seeded_findings.title: CSRF: state-changing transfer accepted without a token
seeded_findings.proof: alice's session POSTs /items/3/transfer without the csrf field and ownership changes to bob

seeded_findings.title: BOLA: cross-user profile read
seeded_findings.proof: alice's session GETs /profile?uid=2 and receives bob's email

negative_controls.signal: admin session reads the admin panel

negative_controls.expected: zero findings; any finding on hardened mode is a false positive
